notes.title: ToT: Do it yourself! Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

New content!

[b]Game settings[/b]
During the first two weeks of playing players reported that certain ToT could feel repetitive, as sentences had often already been seen by all the players involved. To fix this you are now able to control much more which should make all your ToT games feel much more personalized! To personalize your game the host can press the wrench icon in the lobby menu.

[b]Player count[/b]
Another point of feedback is that 5 players is just too little. I totally agree, a party with only 5 people is not complete. That's why 7 players are now able to play a game of ToT simultaneously. The requirements for getting the "The party is complete" achievement have also been changed. (Don't worry, if you already had the achievement, you don't have to find new friends :))

[b]Other pronouns[/b]
For those who want to express themselves as not he or she, that is now possible in the settings menu! A feature that due to time constraints got pushed back a little bit :).

[b]Other new[/b]
A lot of bugs have been killed with this update (for the full list check the next section), 5 new sentences and a new achievement have been added. 

[b]Fixed bugs[/b]
Fixed instance where sentence would get too big
Fixed issue where some sentences would never appear in a real game
Fixed some achievements not triggering
Fixed some artwork on the winner page
Fixed the text on the Info panel
Fixed a bug that did not correctly disconnect a player after a ToT game was played
and many more...


Have fun!
Sivue

notes.title: Hotfix for continue game
notes.content: - Fixed an issue where a majority of votes going towards "Continue" would crash the game

notes.title: Hotfix for certain issues in the lobby
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the game could be started with less than 3 people
- Fixed an issue where the game would send players to the main menu if 1 player disconnected in the lobby
- Fixed an issue where pronouns would not get correctly selected
- Fixed an issue where certain players could never get selected as the player subject

notes.title: Small changes and fixes (16/9/24)
notes.content:
- Fixed small art issues 
- Changed from and to location (Community suggestion)
- Added scrolling to the ticket selection screen when hovering over the area (Community suggestion)

notes.title: Bug fixes and small changes
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where you could not see a connect message when trying to join another player
- Fixed a bug where the wrong text would be shown on the "confirm answer" button
- Changed the timer that introduces the player from 1 sec -> 2.5 sec
- Changed the time a player has to connect to the host from 25 -> 40 seconds

Ty for playing
~ Sivue

notes.title: Color changer fix
notes.content: - Fixed a bug where the color changer did not work

notes.title: Train of Thoughts release!
notes.content:
Hi all,
After 1 year of development, I'm proud to announce that you can play Train of Thoughts officially as of today! A huge milestone for me and I can't thank all of the people who supported me over the past year in this Journey, again many thanks!

[h3]The future[/h3]
We are not done, however! In the first couple of weeks, I'm planning on releasing bug fixes (Which hopefully should not be a lot), and after which I have a few content updates planned! To stay up to date please join the discord using [url=https://discord.gg/K8egWwax8A]this link[/url]!

Again many thanks,
~ Sivue
